items.description: 🐉 DRAGON-AI — is an open-source enterprise Agent platform for building, deploying, and managing AI applications. It combines AI agents, workflows, RAG and knowledge management
items.readme_text:
# 🐉 DRAGON-AI — 可私有部署的多租户 AI 中台 > 把 **模型网关、知识库 RAG、知识图谱、工作流编排、深度探索智能体（Harness）与企业级 RBAC** 收进同一个工作区，数据、模型与权限都由你自己掌握。 > 在线体验：`120.77.58.245:12345`（viewer / viewer） · 中文 / [English](README.en.md) > 本 README 与代码同步维护：**标「已开发」的都能跑，标「规划中」的请当作不可用**。 --- ![DRAGON-AI 总体架构](docs/项目总体架构.drawio.png) ## 一、核心能力 | 模块 | 解决的问题 | 代表能力 | |---|---|---| | 权限与运营底座 | 多人环境下的能力、权限与运行治理 | RBAC、资源级 ACL、审计日志、限流、在线用户与 ARQ 监控 | | 模型网关与模型广场 | 统一接入、分发、治理多供应商模型 | OpenAI 兼容入口、12 类能力 × 3 供应商、申请审批、API Key | | 工作流编排 | 把复杂任务拆成可视化流程 | 21 类节点、submit 契约、人工审批、SSE/WS、记忆、函数调用 | | 知识库与 RAG | 为回答提供精准检索内容 | 三类库、混合检索、图谱增强、RAGAS 评测、开放 API | | 深度探索（Harness） | 让智能体真正执行任务并交付成果 | AgentScope ReAct + 每用户云沙箱、持久化工作区、在线预览与产物交付 | | 执行引擎与基础设施 | 高并发、可横向扩展的运行底座 | arq 四流水线、统一存储（本地/NAS/OSS）、Nacos、trace-id | --- ## 二、能力概览 ### 1. 权限与运营底座（企业级 RBAC） - **权限点即菜单**（`menu_type=3`）：一份数据同时驱动前端按钮显隐与后端 `@has_permission`，ADMIN 直放；五级数据权限（全部 / 本部门及以下 / 本部门 / 仅本人 / 自定义部门集）。 - **资源级 ACL，全平台一套引擎**：知识库 / 文档 / 工作流 / 模板 / 工具 / 技能 / MCP 连接七类资源，按动作粒度授权到 用户 / 角色 / 部门（含下级）/ 用户组 / 全员；判定 = `ADMIN ∪ 归属人 ∪ 数据范围 ∪ 显式授权`。`acl_router` 是唯一读写口、`resource_guard` 单点求值，列表下推 / 行内按钮 / 403 三处共用同一份规则，绝不再手写第二份。 - JWT + Redis 登录态即时失效；全链路 `x-trace-id`、敏感字段自动脱敏；模块桶级限流热加载；在线会话踢出与 ARQ 四流水线监控。 ### 2. AI 模型网关与模型广场 - **OpenAI 兼容统一入口** `POST /api/model`：api-key 鉴权 → 模型一致性校验 → QPS + 日限额 → 厂商直连 → 流式 SSE / 非流式 JSON。 - **12 类模型能力 × 3 家供应商**（OpenAI 兼容 / 通义千问 / 智谱）：文生文、向量、重排、图文/视频理解、OCR、文生图、文/图生视频、文生音频、音频转文字等。 - 能力位 `supports_stream / thinking / function_call` 在模型管理登记，未登记不外发入参；模型广场全流程：接入 → 申请 → 审批 → API Key → 连通性测试 → 动态上下线；网页端多模型对话体验。 ### 3. 工作流 / 智能体编排 - 可视化画布 `{nodes, edges}`：草稿 / 发布 / 版本快照 / 回滚 / 复制，发布前严格图校验（连通性、端口、必填、环路）。 - **21 类节点**：边界、AI（LLM / 分类器 / 参数提取器）、控制流（IF / 循环 / 并行 / 赋值 / 聚合 / 回复 / **审批**）、数据（模板 / 代码 / 列表 / 文档提取 / 知识检索）、外部（HTTP / 工具 / MCP / **子工作流**）。 - **执行契约只有三个概念**：`executionId` / `pendingApprovals` / `submit`——首跑、续跑、重跑、答审批都是同一个 `submit`；人工审批含嵌套冒泡、`approvalToken` 一次性凭据。 - WebSocket + SSE + DB 回放、暂停 TTL 看门狗、单节点超时、任务全局幂等、多轮记忆（可丢弃/自动压缩）、函数调用（LLM 可挂工具 / MCP / 子工作流）。 ### 4. 知识库与 RAG（含检索评测） - **三类知识库**：文档库 / 图文库 / 音视频库分型配置；库表 + ES 双索引 + Neo4j 图谱三份状态由服务层统一维护。 - 解析切片：`common_file_parser` 双引擎（native：pypdf/docx/xlsx… · minerU 私有化 HTTP）+ auto 调度、8 种分块策略，切片经向量模型入 ES `rag_knowledge_chunk`。 - 混合检索：BM25 + 1024 维 dense_vector kNN 按请求动态加权 · 重排模型按请求选 · 可叠加 LightRAG 式图谱检索一路（实体/关系投影入 `rag_kg_vector`）。 - **图谱流水线（graphflow，独立于 ragflow）**：逐批走大模型抽实体/关系入 Neo4j，单篇远慢于解析，拆到独立队列与 `arq_graphflow` worker 避免占满 rag 并发槽位；失败重跑默认断点续抽（只补没抽成的批，不重烧已完成调用）。 - RAGAS 评测 5 大指标 + 三段耗时（召回 / 生成 / 打分），后台异步；开放检索 API（API Key + 限流，单次 ≤100 文件）。 ### 5. 深度探索（Harness 智能体） - **AgentScope ReAct 自主智能体**：对话轮次投递到专属 `harness_queue` 异步消费，每轮占一条模型流 + 一个沙箱会话，与 workflow / ragflow / graphflow 完全隔离。 - **每用户独立云沙箱 + 持久化工作区**（OpenSandbox 自托管）：`workspace_id` 幂等复用、自建镜像自带网关 venv、首建跳过分钟级引导；工作区按用户挂**持久卷**（宿主机 NAS 目录映射到容器 `/workspace`）——**沙箱被服务端按最大存活时间销毁/重建后产出物仍在**；缓存句柄陈旧时向控制面探活、非 running 则逐出重建，保证句柄确实可用。 - **流式时间线对话**：思考 / 工具调用 / 回复按帧到达顺序交错呈现、逐段可折叠；SSE 帧协议 `turn.started / text.delta / thinking.delta / tool.started / tool.completed / turn.artifacts / turn.completed|interrupted|failed`。 - **人在环 AskUser**：执行中可打断向用户要参数/确认后从断点恢复，也支持手动中断，消息行终态为准、幂等收尾；AgentState 存 Redis，API 与 worker 跨进程交接。 - **文件上传优化**：上传经后端专用 `write_file` 直写原始字节（不经 shell、不受单命令行参数上限、无 base64 分块/解码开销）；下载经 `read_file` 整份读原始字节（避开命令通道截断大 stdout）；大文件走对象存储 / OSS。 - **最终输出物自动渲染**：智能体收尾用 `present_output` 显式登记交付物 → `turn.artifacts` 帧随消息落库 → 对话内渲染成可点击**文件卡片**，右侧工作区**多格式在线预览**（图片 / PDF / 音视频 / Markdown / 代码 / CSV / HTML / 文本）；本会话该轮首个产物到达时自动展开预览。 - 挂载资源：技能（SKILL.zip 种入沙箱 `skills/` 分区）、工具、MCP 连接、知识库检索——与选择器同源 ACL 校验，每轮可携带模型与挂载配置。 ### 6. 执行引擎与基础设施 - arq + Redis 分片队列，**workflow / ragflow / graphflow / harness 四条流水线独立消费、互不抢占**；`crc32(task_id) % 切片数` 稳定路由，多进程横向扩展；切片数存 Redis 而非 Nacos，监控页改完即时生效。 - **统一存储抽象** `StorageBackend`：本地目录 / 阿里云 OSS（SDK V2 异步）按 Nacos `storage:` 段或环境变量切换，沙箱持久卷可由宿主机 NAS 挂载；**无盘化**——后端只搬字节，文档解析在内存做。 - Nacos 一个地方管所有环境差异，启动即注册 + 拉配置，代码不写死任何地址；loguru + `x-trace-id` 贯穿网关 → 服务 → worker。 --- ## 三、快速开始 ### 环境要求 | 依赖 | 版本 | 用途 | |---|---|---| | Python | 3.11+ | 后端 | | Node.js / pnpm | 20.12+ / 10+ | 前端构建 | | MySQL | 8.x | 业务数据 | | Redis | 5+（建议 7.x） | 登录态 / 限流 / 队列 | | Nacos | 2.x+ | 注册 + 配置中心，**必须有** | | 阿里云 OSS / NAS | 可选 | 对象存储 / 沙箱持久卷 | | OpenSandbox Server | 自托管（可选） | 深度探索沙箱；不开该功能可不部署 | ### 新环境初始化（四步） 1. **建库灌种子** —— 一份文件搞定 28 张业务表 + 角色 / 管理员 / 部门 / 菜单 / 权限点，重复执行安全（建表 `IF NOT EXISTS`、种子 `INSERT IGNORE`）： ```bash mysql --default-character-set=utf8mb4 -h -u root -p < sql/v2_init.sql ``` 2. **建 Nacos 配置** —— `data_id` = 服务名（`service_system/login/workflow/rag/gateway/harness` 与 `arq_workflow/arq_ragflow`），内容照抄 `sql/init_nacos.yaml` 改连接信息。要点：`arq_*` 的 `redis.url` 必须与对应服务的生产者同源，否则任务投了没人消费；graphflow 不新增 `data_id`，与 ragflow 同读 `arq_ragflow` 段、只队列名独立；深度探索需 `service_harness` 段（opensandbox / agentscope / skills）。 3. **起后端** —— 六个服务 + 四条 worker 流水线，见「本机启动」或「Docker」。 4. **起前端** —— `pnpm build:antd` 出静态产物交 nginx，把 `/api` 反代到网关。 初始账号 `admin / Admin@123`，**首次登录后立即改密码**。存量老库按版本跑 `sql/` 下的增量脚本跟上最新列与权限点。 ### 本机启动 ```bash pip install -r requirements.txt python -m service.service_gateway.gateway # :18000 python -m service.service_system.system # :9001 python -m service.service_login.login # :9004 python -m service.service_workflow.workflow # :9003 python -m service.service_rag.rag # :9002（需 ES + Neo4j） python -m service.service_harness.harness # :9005（需 OpenSandbox 沙箱服务） # arq worker：-t 必填，四条流水线各起一个进程组（队列完全隔离） python -m arq_tasks.run_workers -t workflow -n 4 -p 1 python -m arq_tasks.run_workers -t ragflow -n 2 -p 1 python -m arq_tasks.run_workers -t graphflow -n 2 -p 1 python -m arq_tasks.run_workers -t harness -n 2 -p 1 cd ui-ai && pnpm install && pnpm dev:antd # :5666（已配 /api → 127.0.0.1:18000） ``` ### Docker 只有一个后端镜像 + 一个前端镜像，**容器起哪个进程由注入的 `SERVICE_NAME` 决定**。一键起全部（前后端拆两个 compose，先起后端、前端错峰再 build，避免一次 `--build` 同时编译前后端打爆内存）： ```bash cp docker/.env.example docker/.env # 填 NACOS_ADDR docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.backend.yml up -d --build # 后端：6 服务 + 4 worker（+ 可选 OpenSandbox） docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.ui.yml up -d --build # 前端：等后端起来后单独 build/up # 浏览器开 http://:8080（UI_PORT） ``` compose 已覆盖全部服务与四条流水线；逐容器 `docker run` 示例、环境变量（`SERVICE_NAME` / `NACOS_ADDR` / `<服务名>_port` / `ARQ_WORKERS` / `SPLIT_NUMBER` 等）与启动脚本细节见 `docker/`、`scripts/` 与「相关文档」。`k8s/` 目录预留，尚未编写清单。 --- ## 四、技术栈 | 层 | 选型 | |---|---| | 后端 | Python 3.11 · FastAPI（全异步）· SQLAlchemy 2.0 + aiomysql · Pydantic v2 | | 进程与部署 | gunicorn + UvicornWorker · Docker · Nacos（注册 / 配置中心） | | 数据与中间件 | MySQL 8.x · Redis · 阿里云 OSS · Elasticsearch 8.x · Neo4j 5.x | | 异步任务 | arq 0.28 分片队列，workflow / ragflow / graphflow / harness 四条流水线独立消费、多进程横向扩展 | | 智能体 | agentscope 2.x（ReAct + workspace / 技能框架）· OpenSandbox 自托管云沙箱（每用户持久化 workspace）· MCP 官方 Python SDK | | 检索 | ES 双索引 `rag_knowledge_chunk` + `rag_kg_vector`：BM25 + 1024 维 dense kNN 动态加权 · 重排按请求选 · 可叠加图谱检索一路 | | 文档解析 | `common_file_parser`：native + minerU 双引擎 + auto 调度，8 种分块策略 | | 知识评测 | RAGAS 5 大指标，自写 langchain-core 适配器把本仓模型服务接入裁判 | | 通信 | httpx 全局连接池（HTTP/2）· WebSocket · SSE（sse-starlette） | | 前端 | Vue 3.5 · TypeScript · Vite · vben v5（pnpm + turbo monorepo）· ant-design-vue · Vue Flow · CodeMirror/Monaco | | 鉴权 | JWT + Redis 会话 · API Key 双通道 · RBAC 权限点 | --- ## 五、目录结构 ``` ├── common/ # 公共层：app 引导 / nacos / 中间件 / 权限 / 模型 / 解析 / 存储 / 连接池，不放业务逻辑 ├── service/ # 业务微服务，一服务一端口 │ ├── service_gateway/ :18000 路由转发 + 鉴权 + 限流 + AI 模型网关 │ ├── service_system/ :9001 RBAC + 模型广场 + 运营监控 │ ├── service_login/ :9004 登录注册 │ ├── service_workflow/ :9003 编排域（execution / workflow_engine / routers…） │ ├── service_rag/ :9002 知识库：配置 / 文档 / 检索 / 图谱 / 评测 / 开放 API │ └── service_harness/ :9005 深度探索：会话 / 轮次 / SSE / 沙箱文件代理 + agent（ReAct / workspace 工厂 / 技能种入） ├── arq_tasks/ # 四条流水线的 worker 配置 + 任务函数 + 多进程入口（run_workers -t …） ├── ui-ai/ # 前端 vben v5 monorepo（apps/web-antd 是实际使用的 app） ├── scripts/ # 启动脚本：容器与裸机共用同一份 ├── docker/ # Dockerfile（后端）· Dockerfile.ui（前端）· compose · nginx 模板 ├── sql/ # v2_init.sql（新环境唯一入口）· init_nacos.yaml · old/（历史增量脚本） ├── docs/ # 设计文档 └── k8s/ # 预留 ``` --- ## 六、系统架构 ``` 前端 ui-ai (Vue3 + vben v5) ── 只发 /api/**，同源代理（vite / nginx），浏览器不跨域 │ ▼ service_gateway :18000 ── 唯一对外入口：路由发现(Nacos) · JWT · 限流 · 审计 · x-trace-id · API Key │ /api/model：OpenAI 兼容模型入口（key → 限流 → 厂商 → SSE） ▼ system :9001 · login :9004 · workflow :9003 · rag :9002 · harness :9005 │ │ 异步执行（Redis 分片队列，四条独立流水线） │ arq workflow · arq ragflow · arq graphflow · arq harness ▼ 基础设施 Nacos（注册 + 全部业务配置）· MySQL · Redis · 阿里云 OSS · ES · Neo4j · OpenSandbox 云沙箱（每用户持久化 workspace） ``` **几条贯穿全局的约定**：① 一个 `create_app` 引导所有服务，依赖初始化失败会回滚 Nacos 注册；② 上层鉴权、底层裸查——ES/Neo4j/存储只按服务层下发的 id 白名单裸查，自身不做权限判断；③ 环境差异只存在于 Nacos，代码不写死连接串；④ 存储只搬字节，换后端不改代码。 --- ## 七、开发进度 **✅ 已开发（可直接使用）**：`service_system`（RBAC / ACL / 模型广场 / 监控）、`service_login`、`service_gateway`（含 AI 模型网关）、`service_workflow`（画布 / 21 节点 / submit / 审批 / 记忆）、`service_rag`（三类库 / 混合检索 / graphflow 图谱 / RAGAS 评测 / 开放 API）、`service_harness`（ReAct + 持久化云沙箱 / 时间线 / AskUser / 上传优化 / 产物自动渲染）、`arq_tasks` 四流水线、`common_storage`、`ui-ai` 前端。 **📋 规划中（仅空包骨架，别当能力看）**：`service_datasets`、`service_train`、`service_inference`、`service_eval_model`、`service_notebook`——只预留了包目录、限流桶名与网关别名，无任何接口。 --- ## 八、路线图 1. 知识库：图谱向量投影与检索融合持续调优、音视频库分型深化、graphflow 多切片横向扩容 2. **智能体团队编排**：在深度探索单智能体之上升级为多智能体协作——组合多个角色 / 模型 / 工具 / 挂载资源的智能体成「团队」，任务分派、消息交接与沙箱产物共享 3. 数据集 / 训练 / 推理 / 评估 / Notebook 模块落地 4. K8s 清单与 Helm chart --- ## 九、相关文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | `docs/workflow-execution-contract.md` | 工作流执行域对外契约与内部设计（加任何对外字段必须先改这份） | | `docs/workflow-approval-memory.md` | 审批与记忆的状态机、需求评审结论与实现补记 | | `docs/workflow-design.md` | 编排模块设计 | | `docs/RAG知识库模块开发SPEC.md` | 知识库（RAG）模块需求与设计口径 | | `sql/v2_init.sql` | 新环境数据库初始化唯一入口 | | `sql/init_nacos.yaml` | Nacos 配置样例（storage 段字段含义、arq 流水线同源关系） | ---

items.name: terminal-jarvis
items.description: In the midst of all the tools out there that you can possibly use to keep track of them. Here's a "shovel" that just works to try them all out.
items.readme_text:
# Terminal Jarvis **Command center for orchestrating context switching between coding-agent harnesses** > **Safe Testing Recommended**: Terminal Jarvis is a harness for AI coding tools > that can modify files and execute commands. For the safest experience, test in > a remote development environment such as > [GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/codespaces), > [Coder](https://coder.com/), [DevPod](https://devpod.sh/), or > [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/). [![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/terminal-jarvis.svg?logo=npm&style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/terminal-jarvis) [![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/terminal-jarvis.svg?logo=rust&style=flat-square)](https://crates.io/crates/terminal-jarvis) [![Homebrew](https://img.shields.io/badge/Homebrew-Available-blue.svg?logo=homebrew&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/BA-CalderonMorales/homebrew-terminal-jarvis) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg?style=flat-square)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![Mentioned in Awesome](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mentioned%20in-Awesome-6f42c1?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-latest-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/BA-CalderonMorales/terminal-jarvis/blob/main/docs/index.md) [![Coverage](https://img.shields.io/badge/coverage-report-green.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/BA-CalderonMorales/terminal-jarvis/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Adevelop) A real session, captured on an Omarchy desktop with scripts/demo/record-omarchy.sh -- no compositing, and nothing installed or run. Registries that don't animate GIFs render the static frame docs/demo-tui.png; see docs/demo.md for how both are recorded.
## Install Package mechanics, supported platforms, and update behavior: [Installation](docs/installation.md). ```bash # Cargo cargo install terminal-jarvis # Cargo binary name is terminal-jarvis; add an alias if you want a short call: # echo 'alias tj=terminal-jarvis' >> ~/.bashrc # npm npm install -g terminal-jarvis # The npm package also installs a tj shim, so you can call either: # terminal-jarvis list # or tj list # Homebrew brew install BA-CalderonMorales/homebrew-terminal-jarvis/terminal-jarvis ``` ## Quick Start Inspect and safely gate catalog descriptors for Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Pi, Droid and a variety of other AI assistants from one terminal interface. The modes, the launch guards, and the full command surface: [Usage](docs/usage.md). ```bash # Open the interactive switcher (bare tj on a terminal does the same) terminal-jarvis tui # List every coding agent terminal-jarvis list # See which agents upstream has retired, and what replaced them terminal-jarvis graveyard # Inspect a harness terminal-jarvis show opencode # Preview a capability command terminal-jarvis plan codex headless # Select and verify the active harness terminal-jarvis use opencode terminal-jarvis current terminal-jarvis check # Optional: block harness commands until Trivy clears this workspace terminal-jarvis gate enable trivy terminal-jarvis gate status ``` ## Commands Commands run in one of two ways: headless (`terminal-jarvis `) or inside the interactive switcher (`terminal-jarvis tui`), and every command is the same however you reached the tool: - Installed globally (npm, Homebrew, or Cargo): `terminal-jarvis list` / `tj list` - No install -- run on demand from anywhere: `npx terminal-jarvis list` - Built from source (this repository): `cargo run -- list` First time here? No install needed -- `npx terminal-jarvis tui` opens the switcher directly. **Headless** (`terminal-jarvis ` / `tj `) -- one command per invocation, for scripts, CI, and one-shot tasks: | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `list` | Show all coding agents | | `graveyard` | Retired agents, their date, and their successor | | `check` | Report binary + env readiness | | `show ` | Inspect a harness's capabilities | | `install ` | Install a harness | | `update []` | Upgrade a harness | | `plan [harness] ` | Preview the shell command | | `use ` / `current` | Select / show active harness | | `run [harness] [capability] [args...]` | Execute a capability | | `security [status\|audit\|]` | Security posture | | `gate [status\|list\|enable\|disable\|run]` | Optional local security gate | | `version [--verbose]` / `--version` / `-v` / `--info` | Version info | | `self-update [--dry-run]` / `--update` | Update Terminal Jarvis or print the update command | | `config show` | Active config state | | `auth help ` | Credential setup guidance | | `[harness] [args...]` | Pass-through to harness binary | **Interactive** (`terminal-jarvis tui` / bare `tj` on a terminal) -- the chat-style switcher with the numbered picker and readiness dashboard. Every headless command above also works here, plus: | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `tui` | Open the switcher | | `home` | Back to the welcome frame (works as `clear` too) | | `exit` | Leave the switcher | ## Layout The repository is a few small planes, and every Rust domain is bucketed the same way -- once you can read one, you can read them all. ```text src/ # the std-only Rust CLI ├── main.rs # entry point; lib.rs is the crate root ├── contracts/ # the shared data model (Harness, capabilities) ├── cli/ # parsing, guards, dispatch, tables, help ├── catalog/ # loads and validates the data plane ├── context/ # platform, distribution, active-harness state ├── diagnostics/ # readiness reports, probes, PATH resolution ├── gates/ # optional local security gate (Trivy) ├── runtime/ # executes harness capability commands ├── security/ # credential and effect posture └── tui/ # the interactive switcher (chat-style shell) ``` ```text harnesses// # the data plane: one folder per coding agent ├── index.toml # name, display, binary, env requirements ├── download/index.toml # install without sudo ├── update/index.toml # upgrade without interactive auth ├── headless/index.toml # non-interactive command mode ├── version/index.toml # print installed agent version ├── stats/index.toml # local agent statistics ├── models/index.toml # list available models ├── security/index.toml # sandbox and approval settings ├── ui/index.toml # interactive terminal UI └── yolo/index.toml # bypass safeguards (dangerous) ``` ```text tests/ # integration tests, one binary per domain scripts/bash/ # automation: catalog, delivery, release, verify docs/ # decisions, contracts, usage, demo, legacy build/ # the build script only npm/ homebrew/ # distribution launchers and formulae ``` Each Rust domain inside `src/` keeps the same shape: `index.rs` as the public face, `logic/` for behavior, `structs/` for data, `tests/` for proof, and every file stays at 100 lines or fewer. ## Docs Browse the whole folder from the [docs index](docs/index.md). What this is for, and the catalog truth behind it: [What is this?](docs/what-is-this.md). | Document | What | |---|---| | [Maintainer guide](docs/maintainer.md) | The security model and maintainer notes | | [Installation](docs/installation.md) | Package mechanics, supported platforms, update behavior | | [Usage](docs/usage.md) | Headless vs interactive, launch guards | | [Capability contract](docs/harness-capability-contract.md) | Full breakdown of the 9 capabilities | | [Security gates](docs/security-gates.md) | Optional Trivy scan behavior and configuration | | [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting/index.md) | Triage blocked scans, failed installs, and local issues fast | | [Cataloged agents](docs/supported-agents.md) | All 25 descriptors and support caveat | | [Support matrix](docs/support-matrix.md) | All 225 capability truth rows | | [Development](docs/development.md) | Architecture, verification, and release artifacts | | [Demo](docs/demo.md) | The recording, the agent-handover script, making new demos | | [Legacy notes](docs/legacy-notes.md) | Aliases, plain output behavior, removed experiments |

items.name: free-llm-api-hub
items.description: A continuously-verified dataset of free-tier & trial-credit LLM APIs for developers. Every entry dated, sourced to the provider's own docs, and machine-readable. No hype, no dead links.
items.readme_text:
**A continuously-verified dataset of free LLM & AI-model APIs you can build on.** Free LLM APIs plus adjacent model APIs — image, speech, embeddings, rerank and OCR: free tiers, trial credits and no-cost quotas. Every entry is dated and sourced to the provider's own docs, and what we could not confirm is marked. Just what's actually free, and the fine print that bites. [![Verify](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/actions/workflows/verify.yml) [![Freshness](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/main/badge-freshness.json)](#how-verification-works) [![Verified providers](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/main/badge-verified.json)](docs/methodology.md) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/explorer-freellmapihub.com-0b7285.svg)](https://freellmapihub.com/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) **[🔎 Interactive explorer](https://freellmapihub.com/)** · **[📊 Dataset](data/providers.json)** · **[🧪 How we verify](docs/methodology.md)** · **[➕ Add a provider](CONTRIBUTING.md)** ⭐ **Useful? [Star the repo](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub)** so other builders find it. · 🛠 **Want to help?** Start with a [good first issue](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/contribute) or the [first-contribution steps](CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-contribution-step-by-step).
--- ## TL;DR — pick by what you actually need Each pick links to its full verified profile on the live site. | I want… | Start with | Why | |---|---|---| | **The smartest model, free** | [Google Gemini](https://freellmapihub.com/p/google-gemini) | The only genuinely frontier-class model with a real free tier here — not just open weights | | **The fastest inference** | [Groq](https://freellmapihub.com/p/groq) or [SambaNova](https://freellmapihub.com/p/sambanova) | Purpose-built inference chips — far faster than typical GPU-served APIs | | **The most free volume/day** | [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://freellmapihub.com/p/cloudflare-workers-ai) (10k Neurons) or [OpenRouter](https://freellmapihub.com/p/openrouter) (50 req/day, 1,000 once you have bought $10 of credit) | Highest ceilings for a side project with real traffic | | **No card *and* no phone** | [OpenRouter](https://freellmapihub.com/p/openrouter) or [Google Gemini](https://freellmapihub.com/p/google-gemini) | Groq, SiliconFlow and NVIDIA all gate signup behind phone verification | | **Open weights** (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) | [OpenRouter](https://freellmapihub.com/p/openrouter) or [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://freellmapihub.com/p/cloudflare-workers-ai) | Widest open-model selection on an ongoing free tier | | **Permanently free, no trial clock** | [Z.ai (GLM)](https://freellmapihub.com/p/zai-glm), or [SiliconFlow](https://freellmapihub.com/p/siliconflow) if you can pass China real-name verification | Several models priced at $0 indefinitely, not just for a trial window | | **An OpenAI-compatible endpoint** | [Groq](https://freellmapihub.com/p/groq), [OpenRouter](https://freellmapihub.com/p/openrouter), [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://freellmapihub.com/p/cloudflare-workers-ai) | Point the OpenAI SDK at a new `base_url` and you're done | | **EU / data-sovereignty hosting** | [OVHcloud](https://freellmapihub.com/p/ovhcloud-ai-endpoints) or [Scaleway](https://freellmapihub.com/p/scaleway) | French/EU providers; OVHcloud even has an anonymous, no-account tier | | **Free embeddings & rerank** | [Jina AI](https://freellmapihub.com/p/jina-ai) or [Cohere](https://freellmapihub.com/p/cohere) | 10M free tokens (Jina, OpenAI-compatible) or 1,000 calls/mo (Cohere) | | **Free speech-to-text / TTS** | [Deepgram](https://freellmapihub.com/p/deepgram) or [AssemblyAI](https://freellmapihub.com/p/assemblyai) | $200 (STT and TTS) / $50 (STT) in no-card signup credit | | **A bigger one-time credit** | [Deepgram](https://freellmapihub.com/p/deepgram) ($200, speech) or [AI21 Labs](https://freellmapihub.com/p/ai21) ($10 for 3 months, LLMs) | Large one-time credits that start without a card | | **Something safe to ship commercially** | [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://freellmapihub.com/p/cloudflare-workers-ai) or [Groq](https://freellmapihub.com/p/groq) | Don't restrict the free tier to personal/eval use, the way Cohere and NVIDIA do | Starting points, not guarantees — read the full profile before you build on it. > [!WARNING] > Independent, community-maintained list — **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any provider below.** Free-tier terms change without notice. Always confirm against the provider's own docs (linked in every row) before you rely on anything here. Entries marked ⚠️ are sourced from community tracking and not yet independently re-confirmed — treat them as indicative. ## Contents - [The best free LLM APIs](#the-best-free-llm-apis) — the top picks by score - [Browse by need](#browse-by-need) — collections and guides by constraint - [What's covered](#whats-covered) — the categories, by the numbers - [Notably NOT free](#notably-not-free) — so this list doesn't waste your time - [How verification works](#how-verification-works) — why you can trust a row, and its limits - [How this project is maintained](#how-this-project-is-maintained) — agents under human oversight - [Use the data](#use-the-data) — dataset, JSON API, badge, widget - [Contributing](#contributing) · [Project docs](#project-docs) --- ## The best free LLM APIs Our top 10 by score — computed from the [62 verified providers](data/providers.json) every time the site is built, never hand-ordered and never padded to ten. The three best form the podium. Money adds nothing to the score. Every row links to its full verified profile: free tier, rate limits and the catch are checked against the provider's own docs. The podium and the method are on the [**/best page ↗**](https://freellmapihub.com/best/) and in [how the score works ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/best/methodology/). 💳 no card · 📵 no phone · 📱 phone required · 🏢 commercial OK · 🔬 eval only · 🔌 OpenAI-compatible | # | Provider | Score | What's free | The catch | Verified | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | **[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits)**
💳 no card · 📵 no phone · 🏢 commercial OK · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 67.2
5 of 6 inputs | A rotating set of models with a :free suffix, single API across many providers; availability fluctuates | Terms prohibit reselling API access or developing a competing service; per-model terms still apply. Upstream providers may train on inputs/outputs. Separate settings for free and paid models can exclude providers that train; router-level opt-in logging and safety/legal retention exceptions still apply (official terms, privacy and provider-logging docs read 2026-11-14). | ✅ 2026-11-14 | | 2 | **[Groq](https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits)**
💳 no card · 📱 phone · 🏢 commercial OK · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 64.3
5 of 6 inputs | Open-weight models (GPT-OSS, Qwen) plus Whisper, no credit card required | Limits apply at the organization level, not per API key. Phone verification required at signup | ✅ 2026-11-14 | | 3 | **[SambaNova Cloud](https://cloud.sambanova.ai/plans)**
🏢 commercial OK · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 58.8
4 of 6 inputs | Rate-limited free tier (applies when no payment method is linked) across the models listed in the Free Tier table | Free Tier applies when no payment method is linked to the account; SambaCloud ToS grants a commercial license (no evaluation-only clause). The previously-listed "$5 / 3 months" trial could not be re-confirmed on official pages (2026-07-30). card_required is unconfirmed because SambaNova's own pages disagree (read 2026-10-08): the rate-limits doc (https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits) says "Free Tier: Applied when there is no payment method linked with your account", while the plans page (https://cloud.sambanova.ai/plans) says "Add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests". Settling it needs a real signup, which has not been done. The rate-limits doc (read 2026-10-09) also lists two preview models on the Free Tier at the same 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200,000 TPD (DeepSeek-V3.2, gemma-4-31B-it), described there as having limited capacity and removable at short notice; they are not in models_free. | ✅ 2026-10-09 | | 4 | **[Google Gemini API (AI Studio)](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits)**
💳 no card · 📵 no phone · 🏢 commercial OK · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 57.5
4 of 6 inputs | Gemini 2.5 Flash, 2.5 Flash-Lite, 2.5 Pro (limited), embeddings, TTS models | Free-tier prompts/outputs may be used by Google to improve its products outside the UK/CH/EEA/EU. Since the 2026-03-23 terms, only Paid Services may serve API clients to end users in the EEA/CH/UK. Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash are deprecated; the pricing page announces automatic routing to Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite respectively, billed at their rates, from 2026-12-01 | ✅ 2026-11-14 | | 5 | **[Cloudflare Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/)**
💳 no card · 📵 no phone · 🏢 commercial OK · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 52.0
4 of 6 inputs | 10,000 Neurons/day, all account plans | Resets daily at 00:00 UTC; overage on a Workers Paid plan bills at $0.011/1,000 Neurons. Some models require a paid billing method: Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits; these are outside no-card free access | ✅ 2026-11-14 | | 6 | **[Z.ai (Zhipu AI / GLM)](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing)**
💳 no card · 📵 no phone · 🏢 commercial OK · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 52.0
4 of 6 inputs | GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.7-Flash (text), and GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision) are officially listed as $0 cost (input, cached input, and output) on a permanent basis | Terms of Use prohibit using Z.ai to "develop, train, or enhance any algorithms, models, or technologies that directly or indirectly compete with us" — otherwise general use, including commercial, isn't restricted | ✅ 2026-11-19 | | 7 | **[ModelScope (API-Inference)](https://www.modelscope.cn/docs/model-service/API-Inference/intro)**
💳 no card · 🔬 eval only · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 51.4
4 of 6 inputs | Free API-Inference calls paid with daily 'Magicubes': 200/day for signing in + 50/day after linking an Alibaba Cloud account (do not roll over); calls cost ~0.5 / 1 / 2 Magicubes for lightweight / standard / flagship models | Alibaba's model hub — a different product from Alibaba Model Studio. Requires a ModelScope account bound to an Alibaba Cloud account with real-name (ID) verification — a practical barrier for non-China users. Explicitly non-commercial ("for developers to experience"). No card. The Magicube (魔粒) amounts and per-call costs are on https://www.modelscope.cn/docs/magicube/intro (2026-11-20); API-Inference requires a bound, real-name-verified Alibaba Cloud account. | ✅ 2026-11-20 | | 8 | **[Cohere](https://docs.cohere.com/docs/rate-limits)**
💳 no card · 📵 no phone · 🔬 eval only · 🔌 OpenAI-compat | 46.1
5 of 6 inputs | Trial (evaluation) API keys covering chat, embed and rerank | Free evaluation key; production use requires upgrading to a production key. Cohere privacy policy says trial inputs and outputs may be used for research and product improvement; no trial-specific retention duration is confirmed | ✅ 2026-11-14 | That's the shortlist. The full dataset — all 67 providers, every ongoing tier and one-time credit, filterable and machine-readable — lives in [**data/providers.json**](data/providers.json) and the [interactive explorer ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/). ## Browse by need Focused, always-current collections — each is generated from the dataset and has a live web page too. - **[Free LLM APIs with no credit card](collections/no-credit-card.md)** (53) — start without a payment method · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/no-credit-card) - **[Free LLM APIs with no phone verification](collections/no-phone.md)** (21) — no SMS/phone verification · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/no-phone) - **[Free LLM APIs for commercial use](collections/commercial-use.md)** (24) — safe to ship, not eval-only · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/commercial-use) - **[OpenAI-compatible free LLM APIs](collections/openai-compatible.md)** (30) — drop-in OpenAI SDK swap · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/openai-compatible) - **[Permanently free LLM APIs](collections/always-free.md)** (5) — $0 models, no trial clock · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/always-free) - **[Free multimodal LLM APIs](collections/multimodal.md)** (49) — vision, audio, embeddings · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/multimodal) - **[Free LLM APIs that say they do not train on your prompts](collections/no-training.md)** (18) — says it does not train on your prompts (some only without opt-in) · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/no-training) - **[Free LLM APIs whose free tier renews](collections/renewing-free-tier.md)** (26) — free quotas or credits that reset · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/renewing-free-tier) - **[Free LLM APIs with a free signup credit](collections/free-signup-credit.md)** (31) — one-time signup credits, not renewing allowances · [live page ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/collections/free-signup-credit) **Guides:** [no signup?](https://freellmapihub.com/guides/free-llm-api-no-signup) (no phone and no card does **not** mean no account) · [embeddings / RAG](https://freellmapihub.com/guides/free-embeddings-apis) · [OCR and documents](https://freellmapihub.com/guides/free-ocr-document-ai-apis) · [speech](https://freellmapihub.com/guides/free-speech-to-text-apis) · [image generation](https://freellmapihub.com/guides/free-image-generation-apis) · [all guides and collections ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/guides-and-collections/). Video generation is not a tracked modality; image or vision support does not mean video-generation access. Every provider also has its own page with the full details and a copy-ready quickstart — e.g. [Groq](https://freellmapihub.com/p/groq), [Deepgram](https://freellmapihub.com/p/deepgram), [Jina AI](https://freellmapihub.com/p/jina-ai). ## What's covered Primarily **free LLM (text) APIs** — plus the adjacent model APIs a builder reaches for next: **image generation, speech (STT/TTS), embeddings, rerank and OCR**. Every category is held to the same verification bar. Breakdown is generated from the data: | Category | Providers | Examples | |---|---|---| | **Text / LLM** | 43 | Google Gemini API, Groq, OpenRouter | | **Speech (STT / TTS)** | 26 | Google Gemini API, Groq, Cloudflare Workers AI | | **Embeddings** | 13 | Google Gemini API, Cloudflare Workers AI, Cohere | | **Image generation** | 11 | Cloudflare Workers AI, HuggingFace, OVHcloud AI Endpoints | | **Vision** | 11 | Google Gemini API, OpenRouter, Z.ai | | **OCR / documents** | 8 | OCR.space, LlamaParse, Nanonets | | **Rerank** | 6 | Cohere, Jina AI, Mixedbread | Filter any category live in the [interactive explorer](https://freellmapihub.com/). ## Notably NOT free Worth saying plainly. As of the last verification pass, **OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI do not offer an ongoing free API tier.** Several providers people *assume* are free — **Together AI, DeepInfra, Perplexity's API, Replicate, Featherless AI** — currently require a card or prepayment before any API use, per their own docs. Some have handed out small one-time trial credits at various points, but that's changed repeatedly; check each provider's billing page before assuming anything. For genuinely free access to strong models, your best bets here are **Gemini** (frontier-class) and the free open-weight models on **Groq, OpenRouter, Cloudflare and Z.ai** (SiliconFlow's free models are on its China platform and need real-name verification). Retired or removed after re-verification: **Mistral** ([Free mode no longer includes API access](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/billing-usage/usage-limits); API keys require billing activation and pay-as-you-go, checked 2026-11-14), **GitHub Models** (fully retired by GitHub on 2026-07-30 — playground, catalog and inference API shut down for all customers), **Cerebras** (now listed as a trial credit: the ongoing free tier became a payment-method-gated $5/30-day trial), **Inference.net** (the free tier is gateway/observability only, not free model tokens), and **Hyperbolic** (not included pending a complete inclusion review; the [current public-access check](docs/sources.md#checked-with-what-each-page-says) supersedes the earlier deposit finding). ## How verification works Most "free LLM API" lists are a snapshot someone took once and never touched again. Rate limits get cut, docs URLs move, "free forever" quietly becomes "free for 30 days" — and the list keeps recommending it for another year. This one is a maintained open dataset, built to surface drift instead of hiding it. Full details in **[docs/methodology.md](docs/methodology.md)**; the short version: 1. **Every verified entry carries a `last_verified` date** and a link to the provider's *own* docs. No date + primary source → it ships as ⚠️ unverified, not as fact. 2. **A local re-verification pass** ([docs/update-playbook.md](docs/update-playbook.md)) re-checks each provider's own docs on a rolling basis — a dead or changed source is an early warning that a provider changed something. 3. **The freshness badge is computed from the data,** not written by hand: it is graded on the **oldest** verification in the list, straight from [`providers.json`](data/providers.json). Green while every verified entry is at most 60 days old and at least 70% of rows are verified (see the [freshness rules](docs/freshness-sla.md)), amber once any entry is due for re-verification, red once any entry breaches the 90-day SLA. One forgotten row is enough to move it on rebuild. The README badge reads the last committed `badge-freshness.json`; it can age between committed refreshes even though Pages deploys daily. 4. **The dataset is schema-validated in CI.** A verified entry that's missing its date or source link fails the build — the honesty rule is enforced by machine, not by good intentions. The marked README sections, the badge and the site are generated from the data and checked for drift ([input map](docs/architecture.md)). 5. **Reporting a stale entry takes under a minute** via a [structured form](../../issues/new?template=inaccuracy.yml) that asks for the provider, what changed and a source link. What "verified" covers and where its limits are: [docs/methodology.md](docs/methodology.md) · what earns a spot on the list: [docs/inclusion-criteria.md](docs/inclusion-criteria.md). ## How this project is maintained [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub) [![Dataset: JSON](https://img.shields.io/badge/dataset-JSON%20%2B%20schema-blue.svg)](data/providers.json) The maintainers are [@pacocartones](https://github.com/pacocartones) and [@LeonMAG](https://github.com/LeonMAG). AI agents assist under human oversight with repository checks, human-authored data updates and code. Re-verification is done by a maintainer or, at the owner's request, with AI assistance: official pages are read by isolated read-only fetchers that return verbatim quotes, and the pull request says which method was used ([playbook](docs/update-playbook.md)). Every change still goes through a pull request, a human maintainer reviews it and is responsible for every merge, and every data change carries a link to the provider's own page and the date it was checked. Commit messages carry no AI signature or trailer; this section is where we say it. ## Use the data This is meant to be consumed by machines as much as by humans. - **[`data/providers.json`](data/providers.json)** — canonical dataset, validated against [`data/schema.json`](data/schema.json). Every field explained in [docs/comparison-dimensions.md](docs/comparison-dimensions.md). - **Static JSON API** — [the public JSON dataset](https://freellmapihub.com/providers.json) and the versioned [JSON API](https://freellmapihub.com/api/) are generated from the canonical dataset for programmatic use. ```bash # Every ongoing free tier that needs neither a card nor a phone number: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/main/data/providers.json \ | jq -r '.providers[] | select(.category=="ongoing" and .card_required==false and .phone_required==false) | .name' ``` **Pin a snapshot for reproducible builds.** `main` moves; depend on an immutable tag instead: ```bash curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/v2.14.0/data/providers.json # v2.14.0 was the latest on 2026-11-20; see Releases ``` Tags track the dataset `version` in [`data/providers.json`](data/providers.json) (see [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)) — pin `vX.Y.Z` and bump deliberately. The [live JSON API](https://freellmapihub.com/api/v1/providers.json) always serves the latest `main`. **Vouch for the data from your own README** — embed the live freshness badge: ```markdown [![Free LLM API Hub](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/main/badge-freshness.json)](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub) ``` It renders the age of the oldest verified entry at the last committed badge refresh. It does not recompute with each view; use the live explorer for freshness calculated in the browser. **Embed a live widget** on any site — a compact, always-current list of the top verified free APIs: ```html
``` Self-contained (inline styles, no CSS conflicts). All attributes are optional: `data-count` (1-20, default 6), `data-modality` (`text`, `audio`, `embeddings`, `image`, `vision`, `ocr`, `rerank`), `data-category` (`ongoing` or `trial`; default both), `data-sort` (an explorer sort key - `recommended` (default), `name`, `category`, `free_tier`, `notes`, `verified`). **Follow changes** — [updates page](https://freellmapihub.com/updates) or the [RSS feed](https://freellmapihub.com/feed.xml). ## Contributing [![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md) [![Good first issues](https://img.shields.io/badge/contribute-good%20first%20issues-9c4668.svg)](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/contribute) Found an outdated limit, a dead link, or a provider that belongs here? You'll keep this useful for everyone. - **Your first PR:** [choose a task, coordinate and run its checks](CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-contribution-step-by-step). - **Fastest report:** the [structured issue form](../../issues/new?template=inaccuracy.yml) — provider, what changed, a source link. - **For a provider-data correction:** edit [`data/providers.json`](data/providers.json), run `npm run build && npm test`, and commit the generated files with the data. Never hand-edit the tables — they're generated. Full guidelines, including what counts as an acceptable source: **[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)**. ### AI-assisted contributions are welcome Use AI tools if they help you — we do too. We ask for good judgement: understand and test what you send, and check every fact at its source. See [AI_POLICY.md](AI_POLICY.md). ### Where to start 1. Pick a [*good first issue*](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/contribute). Each one names the files and the check. A `good first issue` also labelled `data` is not claimed; for other issues, comment `/take` before starting (`/release` frees it). 2. Confirm a provider fact from the umbrella issues: [**`phone_required`**](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/issues/7) or [**`commercial_ok`**](https://github.com/pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub/issues/8) (read the provider's terms). For a provider fact, cite the provider's own page and the day you read it (UTC); if you cannot confirm it, leave the data unchanged and tell us what you read. Ready for more? Follow the [path from good first issue to help wanted](CONTRIBUTING.md#from-good-first-issue-to-help-wanted). ## Project docs | Doc | What it covers | |---|---| | [Methodology](docs/methodology.md) | How each entry is verified; what "verified" does and doesn't mean | | [Update playbook](docs/update-playbook.md) | The weekly routine that keeps the badge green | | [Inclusion criteria](docs/inclusion-criteria.md) | What earns a spot — and what gets rejected | | [Comparison dimensions](docs/comparison-dimensions.md) | Every field and flag in the dataset, defined | | [Self-hosting on free compute](docs/self-hosting-on-free-compute.md) | Adjacent: free GPU/compute when no hosted API fits | | [Credit programs (apply to get)](docs/credit-programs.md) | Adjacent: startup & student/research credit programs | | [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md) | Where this is going next | | [AI policy](AI_POLICY.md) | AI-assisted contributions are welcome; what we ask in return | | [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) | What changed, when | | [Governance](GOVERNANCE.md) | How decisions get made | | [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | Reporting & community norms | ## License [MIT](LICENSE) — free to reuse, fork, and adapt, including the dataset. A link back is appreciated but not required.

items.name: apple-rag-mcp
items.description: Apple developer knowledge for AI agents via MCP or CLI. Search docs and WWDC transcripts with Jev-ranked hybrid retrieval, browse SwiftUI and UIKit by topic, and read source pages.
items.readme_text:
# Apple RAG ### Apple developer knowledge for your AI agent. *Give your agent Apple documentation and WWDC26 transcripts through MCP or CLI. RAG retrieval finds the sources, and [Jev](https://typesafe.ai/) ranks the results.* [Website](https://apple-rag.com) · Powered by [ Jev](https://typesafe.ai/) [![CI](https://github.com/BingoWon/apple-rag-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/BingoWon/apple-rag-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Listed on mcpservers.org](https://mcpservers.org/badge.svg)](https://mcpservers.org/servers/bingowon/apple-rag-mcp) · **English** | [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## What your agent can do Choose the tool that fits the question. A single call can be enough. | Tool | When to use it | | --- | --- | | `search` | Find an API or a WWDC discussion with an English query. Keyword and semantic search find relevant passages. | | `browse` | Explore SwiftUI or UIKit without guessing URLs. Follow Apple’s topic groups from a framework to its APIs. | | `fetch` | Read the source page for a search result or catalog entry, or open a URL you already have. | All three tools are available through MCP and the CLI. The [dashboard](https://apple-rag.com/overview) shows calls by tool, links to the corresponding logs, and your remaining weekly allowance. ### Powered by [ Jev](https://typesafe.ai/) [Jev](https://typesafe.ai/), a decision model, scores candidate Apple documentation and video transcripts against each query's API, platform, and version requirements. We use its relevance scores to rank the sources returned through MCP or CLI. A backup reranker takes over if the API call fails. --- ## Hosted and Ready to Use The [hosted service](https://apple-rag.com/) connects your agent to an Apple knowledge base that is already collected, cleaned, and indexed. - **Ready-to-query sources:** Official developer documentation and video transcripts, available through one connection. - **Retrieval model calls included:** Embeddings, [Jev](https://typesafe.ai/) ranking, and the backup reranker run on our service. - **Ongoing upkeep:** We handle content collection, index updates, database backups, and protocol compatibility. The hosted service operates the database, refreshes the corpus, and manages retrieval model credentials. The CLI is distributed separately; the application source is public. When reading a page, `fetch` checks the index first, follows Apple redirects, and can fall back to official document JSON or live extraction. Results identify the source and retrieval method. Third-party pages stay outside the Apple search index. See [web retrieval operations](ops/web-retrieval.md) for limits and log details. [Start free](https://apple-rag.com/). [Pro](https://apple-rag.com/#pricing) includes 50,000 tool calls/week and 50/minute for $1/week, shared by `search`, `browse`, and `fetch`. --- ## Connect your agent Open the [connection guide](https://apple-rag.com/connect), copy a setup prompt, and paste it into your agent’s conversation. - **MCP** is the recommended choice for agents with native MCP support. To use your account allowance, copy the personalized prompt from your [dashboard](https://apple-rag.com/overview). - **CLI** gives shell-based agents the same tools. The [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/apple-rag-cli) includes the CLI and an agent skill. You approve account access in your browser. ### One-click setup for Cursor [![Install MCP Server](https://cursor.com/deeplink/mcp-install-light.svg)](https://cursor.com/en/install-mcp?name=apple-rag-mcp&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL21jcC5hcHBsZS1yYWcuY29tIn0%3D) Open [Cursor](https://cursor.com) and confirm installation. ### Manual setup for other MCP clients **JSON Configuration (Copy & Paste):** This is a configuration example, not a universal client format. The dashboard also retains manual configuration examples. ```json { "mcpServers": { "apple-rag-mcp": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.apple-rag.com" } } } ``` **Manual Configuration Parameters:** - **MCP Type:** `Streamable HTTP` - **URL:** `https://mcp.apple-rag.com` - **Protocol:** `2026-07-28`, with legacy `initialize` support for `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`, and `2025-03-26` - **Authentication:** `Optional` (MCP Token for higher limits) - **MCP Token:** Get yours at [apple-rag.com](https://apple-rag.com) for increased quota Saving a configuration alone does not verify a working connection. > **Note:** No MCP Token required to start! You get free queries without any authentication. Add an MCP Token later for higher usage limits. ## 🌟 Built for AI agents
### ⚡ **Fast & Reliable** Get quick responses with our optimized search infrastructure. No more hunting through docs. ### 🎯 **AI-Powered Hybrid Search** Hybrid search combines keyword and semantic retrieval for Apple documentation and video transcripts. [Jev](https://typesafe.ai/) then ranks the combined candidates against your question, giving your agent more relevant context. ### 🔒 **Account Access** Use separate MCP and CLI credentials with shared account quotas and individually revocable access. ### 📝 **Source References** Results include source URLs so agents can verify API details and cite their references. ### 🔄 **Maintained Sources** Our collector checks Apple documentation and developer video transcripts on a regular schedule. ### 🆓 **Start Free** Try without an account: 30 tool calls/week and 3/minute. Register at [apple-rag.com](https://apple-rag.com/) for 50/week and 5/minute, shared by `search`, `browse`, and `fetch`.
## 🎯 Features - **🔍 Semantic Search** - Vector similarity with semantic understanding for intelligent retrieval - **🔎 Keyword Search** - Precise technical term matching for API names and specific terminology - **🎯 Hybrid Search** - Combines keyword and semantic retrieval - **📚 Apple Developer Sources** - Search the indexed documentation corpus; coverage depends on collection and indexing. - **🎬 Developer Videos** - Search indexed WWDC and Apple developer video transcripts. - **⚡ Fast Response** - Optimized for speed across all content types - **🔌 MCP / CLI** - Native MCP tools or shell commands for AI agents. - **🔄 Scheduled Collection** - Sources are collected and indexed regularly; updates are not guaranteed to appear immediately. - **🛡️ Secure & Private** - Your queries stay private - **🌐 MCP 2026 Native** - Stateless MCP `2026-07-28`, with legacy Streamable HTTP compatibility ## 📄 License The CLI client is distributed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). The application source is available in this public repository.
--- **Better docs. Better context. Better code.** [Get Started →](https://apple-rag.com)
